title: Rock-a-bye Baby: Why Animals Hibernate and Sleep All Winter!

lines.text: Rock-a-bye baby on the tree top, when the wind blows the cradle will rock!
lines.caps: Rock-a-bye baby on the *TREE | top, when the wind *BLOWS | the cradle will *ROCK!

lines.text: But in deep winter dens, why do bears and sleepy animals nap for months on end?
lines.caps: But in deep winter *DENS, | why do bears and sleepy animals nap for *MONTHS | on *END?

lines.text: In freezing winter, berries disappear and bugs hide, leaving very little food!
lines.caps: In freezing winter, berries *DISAPPEAR | and bugs hide, leaving very little *FOOD!

lines.text: Instead of hunting in the snow, animals enter a superpower state called Hibernation!
lines.caps: Instead of hunting in the *SNOW, | animals enter a superpower state called *HIBERNATION!

lines.text: A bear's heart slows down from fifty beats a minute to just eight beats!
lines.caps: A bear's heart slows *DOWN | from fifty beats a minute to just *EIGHT | *BEATS!

lines.text: Their body cools down and their engine runs in ultra power-saving mode!
lines.caps: Their body cools *DOWN | and their engine runs in ultra power-saving *MODE!

lines.text: They survive all winter by slowly burning energy stored in their autumn fat layer!
lines.caps: They survive all *WINTER | by slowly burning energy stored in their autumn *FAT | *LAYER!

lines.text: When warm spring sunshine returns, they wake up refreshed and ready to play!
lines.caps: When warm spring sunshine *RETURNS, | they wake up refreshed and *READY | to *PLAY!

lines.text: Wake up to daily learning and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *WAKE up to daily | *LEARNING and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo!
